# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L2/203_curate_acknowledgements.qmd")

# Point to directories
L0_data_dir <- here("data", "L0") # L0 data
L1_data_dir <- here("data", "L1") # L1 data
L2_data_dir <- here("data", "L2") # L2 data
```


# Read data

```{r}
#| label: read-inat-ept-data
# Read in EPT data from iNaturalist
ETF_EPT_inat_df <- readRDS(here(
  L1_data_dir,
  "103a_ETF_EPT_final_annotated.rds"
)) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(here(L0_data_dir, "004_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.csv")),
    join_by("observation_id" == "id")
  )

# Join iNat metadata to study observations
ETF_EPT_metadata_df <- ETF_EPT_inat_df |>
  select(species, life_stage, observation_id, evidence_type) |>
  left_join(
    # Read in iNat metadata
    read_rds(here(
      L1_data_dir,
      "101a_images_clean_ETF_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  )

table(ETF_EPT_inat_df$species, ETF_EPT_inat_df$life_stage)
```


# Get users

```{r}
#| label: get-observers
ETF_EPT_observers_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df |>
  distinct(user.id)

ETF_EPT_OBS_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df |>
  select(user.id, id = observation_id) |>
  mutate(id = as.character(id))
```


```{r}
#| label: get-identifiers
ids_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df$identifications
identifiers_data <- tibble()

identifiers_data <- bind_rows(ids_df)

# Get identifiers & ID data
ETF_EPT_identifiers_df <- identifiers_data |>
  distinct(user.id)
ETF_EPT_IDS_df <- identifiers_data |>
  select(user.id, id) |>
  mutate(id = as.character(id))

rm(identifiers_data, ids_df)
```

```{r}
#| label: get-annotators
anns_df <- ETF_EPT_metadata_df$annotations
annotators_data <- tibble()

annotators_data <- bind_rows(anns_df)

# Get annotators & annotation data
ETF_EPT_annotators_df <- annotators_data |>
  distinct(user.id)
ETF_EPT_ANN_df <- annotators_data |>
  select(user.id, id = uuid) ## Annotation data only has `uuid`!!!

rm(annotators_data, anns_df)
```

# Join User data

```{r}
#| label: join-dfs
ETF_EPT_users <- bind_rows(
  ETF_EPT_annotators_df,
  ETF_EPT_identifiers_df,
  ETF_EPT_observers_df
) |>
  distinct()

ETF_EPT_contrib_info <- bind_rows(
  "annotation" = ETF_EPT_ANN_df,
  "observation" = ETF_EPT_OBS_df,
  "identification" = ETF_EPT_IDS_df,
  .id = "contribution_type"
)
```


```{r}
#| label: Export-data
write_csv(ETF_EPT_users, here(L2_data_dir, "203a_ETF_EPT_inat_users.csv"))

write_csv(
  ETF_EPT_contrib_info,
  here(L2_data_dir, "203b_ETF_EPT_inat_contributed_info.csv")
)
```
